NISAR, a joint NASA and ISRO satellite,: NISAR, a joint NASA and ISRO satellite, launched on 30 July 2025 from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, India.

Carrying both an L-band and an S-band ra: Carrying both an L-band and an S-band radar on one spacecraft is a first, which makes NISAR more capable than earlier radar missions.
Each of NISAR's radars is sensitive to f: Each of NISAR's radars is sensitive to features of different sizes and detects attributes such as moisture content, surface roughness and motion.
NISAR's data help determine how quickly: NISAR's data help determine how quickly glaciers and ice sheets are changing, with unprecedented coverage of Antarctica.
